subject: Vendor onboarding & PO / billing cadence — ClearWave payment lane sync
messages:
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@clearwave.tech>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor onboarding — ClearWave (billing)

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick intro. We're ready to complete Redwood's vendor onboarding so we can receive POs and bill per the upcoming integration. A few items for alignment on our side:

- Preferred payment cadence: we'd like to request Net 45 as standard for this engagement.
- Early-pay option: our finance team can accept a 1.5% discount for Net 15 if Redwood has an early-pay program and a straightforward enrollment flow.
- Invoicing: we normally include PO reference and line-level detail; is that required to avoid remittance delays?

Attached: clearwave_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and W-9_ClearWave.pdf.

Can you confirm next steps (who completes which fields, where to upload bank details for early pay review)? Also copying our AP alias (accounts@clearwave.tech).

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Sarah Lopez
Head of Finance Ops | ClearWave Inc.
T: +1 415-555-0198
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@clearwave.tech>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — ClearWave (billing)

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending these over and for the clear notes.

Short answers up front:
- Redwood standard is Net 30, but we can support Net 45 or Net 60 based on negotiated terms for this engagement. Please confirm Net 45 if that's preferred.
- Early-pay (discount) enrollment is possible — we run that as an optional add-on. Finance needs a short addendum + bank verification via our vendor portal to enable auto-approval.
- PO requirement: yes, all invoices should reference the PO number we issue. Line-level detail is preferred for faster invoice matching in our AP system.

I've attached a quick checklist (redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf) that shows the typical flow and who completes each item. Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm final payment cadence (Net 30/45/60) — reply to this thread.
2) Complete any missing fields on your onboarding PDF and re-upload.
3) If you'd like early-pay, indicate interest and we will send the DocuSign addendum + secure portal link to collect bank details.

Karthik — can you confirm whether ClearWave needs any special PO routing (e.g., multiple cost centers) or a purchase order template?

Thanks,
Monica
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@clearwave.tech>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@clearwave.tech
Date: 2026-09-17T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — ClearWave (billing)

Thanks Monica — we'll go with Net 45 as the default.

A couple of follow-ups:
- Early-pay: yes, we'd like to enroll. Please send the addendum and the secure bank-collection link.
- Invoice format: we can include PO number + line-level descriptions. Can you confirm minimum required fields so our billing team formats invoices correctly?
- PO references: will Redwood always include a PO number on each requisition? Sometimes we receive blank PO fields from other partners and it causes delays.

I'll have our AP team upload the completed onboarding PDF and re-send the W-9 if you need a different format. If it helps, happy to put a 15-minute slot on calendars to finalize.

Best,
Sarah
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@clearwave.tech>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — ClearWave (billing)

Hi Sarah — cc'd Monica and Karthik. I'm the finance partner handling vendor setup for this region. Quick note on the operational details so your AP team can proceed smoothly: 

1) Required onboarding items (we received most of these already):
   - Completed vendor onboarding form (we need the banking section filled if enrolling in early-pay)
   - Signed W-9 (we have the PDF you attached)
   - Backup contact for billing and dispute resolution

2) PO / invoice expectations:
   - Redwood issues a PO for each purchase; please include the PO number in the invoice header (field labeled "PO #").
   - Invoice must include invoice number, invoice date, line descriptions, quantity/price, and total. If you send an invoice without PO # there will be a manual hold.

3) Early-pay enrollment process:
   - We require a signed Early Pay Addendum (DocuSign link below) and vendor bank info via our secure portal.
   - After we complete verification, finance will set your vendor record to "early-pay eligible" and you will see an option at invoice submission to opt into accelerated payment at the agreed discount.

DocuSign addendum: https://www.docusign.com/early-pay-addendum/HW-2859
Secure portal (bank details): https://secure.redwood.com/vendor-portal/enroll
PO template (attachment): PO_template.docx

If you confirm Net 45 and that you'd like to proceed with early-pay, we'll:
- Send the addendum for signature
- Enable the portal for bank collection once that's signed
- Create the vendor record and issue the first PO after onboarding is complete

Let me know if you'd prefer a short call to walk through any of these steps. Otherwise, Monica will coordinate the PO routing after your vendor record is active.

Thanks,
David Kim
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
